narrative: 一个念头落地。不要急于求成。
这个镜头的任务是顿悟、谎言、陷阱，而不是展示设备本身。即使移动距离只有一米，视差依然会出现，因为机位本身发生了变化。
如果你想要的是固定机位带来的光学压缩，或者一次作为空间叙事的长距离推轨，那么这就不是合适的工具。如果你再加上第二个花哨的动作，这个念头就消失了。
how: 在Z轴上使用推轨、滑轨、斯坦尼康，或虚拟摄影机，通常从中景推到中近景。保持镜头焦距固定，让这次推进依靠距离而不是变焦来实现。
微小的视差就是真实感的证明。提示词：一次几乎难以察觉的缓慢推进，从中景推到中近景，墙壁在人们意识到运动之前就已经收拢。
when: 当一个念头需要落地、不应急于求成时使用。具体场景：一个倾听者意识到自己已被识破，用6秒钟从中景推到中近景。
不要在每一句台词上都用推镜头。
vs: 推轨推进（Dolly In）特指带轮支撑装置，通常移动距离更长，作为一种空间叙事。慢速变焦推近（Slow Zoom In）从不移动摄影机，因此没有视差。
推镜头是一种制造压迫感的节拍：短促、可以是物理的或虚拟的，与一个念头紧密相连。如果轨道长达整个房间，那你做的其实是推轨。
examples_film: 《沉默的羔羊》（The Silence of the Lambs）用缓慢的实拍靠近，让对话变成陷阱。《闪灵》（The Shining）和《血色将至》（There Will Be Blood）让微小的推进被感知为一种心理层面的天气变化。
要学的是这种耐心和视差，而不是照搬某位演员的走位。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是慢速变焦推近。破绽在于画面放大，前景却没有产生滑动。
解决办法：让摄影机真正靠近，焦距固定，路径短促，结束在这个念头上，不再添加额外的运动。

faq.q: 电影中的推镜头（Push In）是什么？
faq.a: 它是摄影机朝主体做的一次短促、通常缓慢的前进，因为镜头占据了更近的位置，画面因此收紧。

faq.q: 推镜头（Push In）与推轨推进（Dolly In）的区别
faq.a: 推轨推进特指带轮或沿轨道的位移，可以是一次跨越较长空间的进入。推镜头则是制造压迫感的手法：通常更短促，有时是虚拟的，但始终与一个念头的落地紧密相连。

faq.q: 什么时候该用推镜头（Push In）？
faq.a: 当一次顿悟或陷阱需要收拢一张脸周围的空气时使用。不要把它当作每个特写的默认手法。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写推镜头（Push In）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明：极缓慢的推镜头，摄影机逐渐靠近，从中景推到中近景，持续6秒，不使用光学变焦。并提及轻微的视差。

narrative: A thought lands. Do not rush it.
The job is the realization, the lie, the trap, not the display of a rig. Parallax still appears, even if the travel is only a meter, because the station point changes.

It is the wrong tool when you wanted optical compression from a locked body, and the wrong tool when you wanted a long track into a room as geography. If you add a second flourish, the thought is gone.
how: Dolly, slider, Steadicam, or virtual camera on the Z axis, usually from medium to medium close-up. Keep the lens fixed so the push is distance, not zoom.
Tiny parallax is the honesty. Prompt an imperceptibly slow push in, medium into medium close-up, walls closing before the motion is noticed.
when: Use it when a thought lands and you should not rush it. Concrete beat: a listener understands they are caught, medium to MCU over 6 seconds.
Do not push in on every line.
vs: A Dolly In names the wheeled support and often travels farther, as geography. A Slow Zoom In never moves the camera, so there is no parallax.
Push in is the pressure beat: short, physical or virtual, tied to a thought. If the track is a room long, you are dollying.
examples_film: The Silence of the Lambs uses slow physical approaches so conversations become traps. The Shining and There Will Be Blood let small advances register as mental weather.
Use the patience and the parallax, not a particular actor's blocking as a clone.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Slow Zoom In. The tell is enlargement without sliding foreground.
The fix: translate closer, fixed lens, short path, end on the thought, no extra move.

faq.q: What is Push In in film?
faq.a: It is a short, usually slow advance of the camera toward a subject so the frame tightens because the lens occupies a nearer station.
Dolly in specifies a wheeled or tracked translation and can be a long geographic enter. Push in is the pressure job: often shorter, sometimes virtual, always tied to a thought landing.

faq.q: When should I use Push In?
faq.a: When a realization or trap should close the air around a face. Do not use it as a default on every close-up.

faq.q: How do I prompt Push In for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write very slow push in, camera walking closer, medium to MCU, 6 seconds, no optical zoom. Mention slight parallax.
